qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (all 6 artifact hashes and matching_source_files hashes re-verified: match)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open with 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (render/prompt.md:1, constraints/prompt.md:1, functional/prompt.md:1, polish/prompt.md:1; visual/prompt.md:1-2 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), and every judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (functional additionally wires the verifier restart_app server). Browser-only scope is explicit: render:2 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints:2 'Use browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only'; polish:4 'Judge the rendered product and interactions, not code style'; visual:10-16 'judge ONLY the rendered presentation'; functional:21-28 requires evidence gathered in-session per criterion, each step reported with what was actually seen, skipped/substituted steps fail, and :34-39 forbids guessing routes and 'Never use curl or shell commands' (replays are in-page fetches of recorded requests). All prompts treat submitted 'source' as untrusted evidence and carry the checker-not-fixer rule. First-paint guessing is excluded: the scored-prompt global gate says 'Protected content must contain real task data backed by the running local server; a first-paint imitation does not pass' (functional:11-19, polish:10-18, visual:18-26); the constraints gate criterion requires post + reload + second-context readback (constraints judge.toml criterion server_backed_local_application). Every criterion in all five judge.toml files is a browser procedure (sign-in, post, record/replay in-page, separate contexts, viewport resize, documentElement.scrollWidth, restart_app then fresh page); none can be scored from source or memory. app_context.md:26 keeps every address on localhost:3000 (no public URL; Colderwater lesson 13), and integration.md:3 publicly requires port 3000, so a conforming app is reachable at the URL every prompt opens. Template diff: task changes only add the checker-not-fixer paragraph, a stronger gate, evidence discipline and task-state sections; the template's Playwright directive lines are preserved verbatim. Probes: (a) static shell / first-paint facade with seeded-looking data -> fails constraints gate (cross-context readback of a new post) and the scored gates; (b) a judge tempted to read /app source (test.sh chmods /app a+rX) -> prompts make source untrusted and require quoted in-session browser observations per step, so a source-based verdict is a prompt violation, not an allowed path; (c) conforming app using different routes/cookie names -> functional Guardrails 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable' and replays use recorded requests, so it is not failed by URL guessing. RISK (evidence gap, not a defect): raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; the only runtime evidence is a scripted Playwright golden run, not a claude-code judge transcript, so it is unmeasured whether the configured judge actually drives the browser rather than reading the readable /app source or stopping at first paint. A configured judge run's tool-call transcript is needed to confirm.
